findings: All dependencies pre-installed. Baseline: 23 pass, 53 fail (76 total). All failures are description too short (<30 chars). extract_yaml.py had 3 bugs fixed: (1) prompt asked for non-schema fields (language, license, pipeline_tag) causing additionalProperties validation failure, (2) references field lacked structure documentation so LLM output strings instead of objects, (3) no YAML fix-up for unquoted colons or type coercion for release_date. After fixes, extraction works successfully with glm-4.5-air model. LLM API endpoint and credentials confirmed working.
